$comment: Domain vocabulary. Advisory for code strings: where this file and docs/PRD.md disagree, the PRD wins. In design artifacts 'forbid' entries are errors; an entry with 'openDecision' is non-binding until the owner decides it (the table at the end of rules.md). Rules: MDS-WORD-01.

fields.ui: the Turkish word or label as the UI writes it (sentence case where it is a label)
fields.short: the short form, where one exists
fields.plural: the plural, where it is irregular or easy to get wrong
fields.example: the word in a real label
fields.display: how the word is drawn when that is not obvious
fields.means: what the word refers to, in English
fields.notMeaning: readings this word must never carry
fields.forbid: words not to use for this meaning: a string, or { text, use } naming the replacement
fields.forms: the qualified forms to use where two kinds can meet on one screen
fields.reserved: true: the word is kept for this meaning, often a module not built yet; use it for nothing else
fields.openDecision: the open decision this entry waits on; until then the entry is non-binding
fields.default: what the UI uses while the decision is open

terms.means: the institution; the optional layer above köşk (PRD §4.1). What the owner calls 'okul'.
a subject lodge that hosts courses, independent or under one medrese (PRD §4.2)
the container that holds the weeks. The PRD's glossary calls it 'ders'; the brief says 'kurs (also called ders)'.
one teaching unit inside a week; also the act ('ders vermek', 'Derse katıl')
one dated live meeting of a canlı ders; it owns its meeting link
a week of the müfredat
terms.display: Hafta 3 (as an eyebrow: CSS uppercase under lang="tr")

terms.means: the course's weeks and lessons
the lesson type LIVE. Its live-now state is 'Şu an canlı' (content/status-map.json).
the time + title rows of one oturum (schema: lessons.agenda)
a study circle — descriptive prose only, never a type label or an entity name
the scholarly discussion module (PRD M7, Phase 3); also allowed inside müderris-authored titles
guided preparatory close reading (PRD M6, Phase 2)
a marginal annotation (PRD M11, Phase 4)
a commentary on a classical text — content (titles), not a UI entity
an exercise set — content only; the assignment entity is 'ödev' (PRD M9)
homework (PRD M9, Phase 2)
memorisation (PRD M5)
one flashcard
a deck of ezber kartları
a source or reference attached to a course
a chain-authorised teaching licence (PRD §4.2, M12) — not a completion certificate. The PRD spells it 'icazet'.
a participation-level completion document (PRD M15-2), distinct from icâzet
a recording attached to an oturum; not a VIDEO lesson
enrol directly, when the course needs no approval
enrol when the course requires approval
create a Medaris account
a manager's soft delete; reversible from 'Arşiv' with 'Geri al'
the sistem yöneticisi's only; the dialog names what is lost
management vocabulary, always with a reason. The affected talebe reads 'erişim', never 'yasak'.
a URL. Qualify it where two kinds can meet on one screen.
governs a medrese (PRD §3). The owner sees the role as a moderator; its powers are still open in the launch plan. The app is 'Nazır' in the UI and nazir in code.
forbid: nazir (for the role, in UI copy)

format.duration: sessions in minutes, always 'dk' ('60 dk'); course totals in hours, 'saat' ('22 saat'), shortened to 'sa' only in dense rows
format.time: 24-hour, weekday short from Intl ('Cmt 21:00'); long date 'd MMMM yyyy EEEE' from Intl ('3 Ekim 2026 Cumartesi')
format.timezone: when the viewer's zone differs from the course's: '21:00 İstanbul · 20:00 senin saatinle' (tedris) / '… sizin saatinizle' (nizam); city names from content/time-zones.json
format.case: toLocaleUpperCase('tr-TR'); CSS text-transform only under lang='tr'
